title: HAZOP Study Management
overview: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability) studies are widely regarded as one of the most effective hazard identification methods, applied across numerous industries. This systematic, structured approach helps identify countless potential risks and operational issues. However, the success of a HAZOP study heavily depends on strong leadership. Without proper guidance, studies can stray from their purpose, turning into mere design reviews or, worse, leading to contractual disputes. This course is designed to provide participants with a solid understanding of the HAZOP methodology and the essential skills to assume the role of a HAZOP Team Leader.
Participants will learn how to lead a HAZOP study, including selecting and preparing a team, choosing nodes, estimating timelines, avoiding common pitfalls, and creating effective reports.
audience: This course is intended for professionals who are required to lead HAZOP studies across any industry. Participants should have prior experience as team members in HAZOP studies and should already have a basic understanding of the HAZOP methodology (which will be reviewed from a leadership perspective during the course).
methodology: The course incorporates case study examples to focus on the key elements of HAZOP leadership. Participants will actively engage in workshops, taking on the roles of Leader and Scribe to practice guiding a team through the HAZOP process. A proprietary HAZOP software package will be demonstrated, allowing participants to set up a study and apply their knowledge. The course includes a hands-on practical exercise where participants will recreate a full HAZOP study, from preparation to making recommendations for organizational improvements.
competencies: Developing and preparing a HAZOP study
Leading and managing a HAZOP study
Writing clear and effective HAZOP study reports
Managing and motivating a HAZOP study team
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Prepare for a successful HAZOP study, defining scope and timelines clearly.
Select and motivate the right team to ensure the study is completed on time with quality results.
Guide productive HAZOP study meetings to achieve actionable outcomes.
Address and solve problems that arise during the HAZOP study process.
Create clear, user-friendly HAZOP study reports.
Analyze results from HAZOP studies and propose organizational improvements
